svg.text: CLASS A: 18,000 ft MSL up to FL600 (IFR only)
CLASS E: controlled airspace up to (not including) 18,000 MSL
Dashed line: Class E floor, usually 1,200 AGL (700 AGL near some airports).
Class G (uncontrolled) lies below it. Class C shelf: 1,200 to 4,000 AGL.
Typical shapes, not a specific airport. Not to scale.
